_about: Hand-checked facts about NPCs that QuestieDB's WoW Forever data has wrong. tools/objectives/gen.py and tools/routes/gen.py apply them to the data before anything else. 'faction' replaces the NPC's friendlyToFaction (A, H or AH): a giver marked as one faction's makes all their quests that faction's only. Every entry names where it was checked (src). Add only what a source or an in-game check confirms.

<NPC ID>.name: NPC name, to read the file by
